    <oap:target id="celery-worker-service-image">image: notification-service</oap:target>
    <oap:target id="celery-worker-service-command">command: celery -A app.celery worker --loglevel=info</oap:target>
    <oap:target id="celery-worker-service-env-file">env_file:
      - <oap:target id="celery-worker-env-file-path">./notification-service/.env</oap:target></oap:target>
    <oap:target id="celery-worker-service-networks">networks:
      - <oap:target id="shared-network-name-11">app-network</oap:target></oap:target>
  </oap:target>
